name: blocksize-market-data
description: Read-only authenticated Blocksize live market data for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Blocksize Market Data gives ChatGPT and Codex read-only access to Blocksize's institutional real-time market data. Search the instrument catalog, check coverage and freshness, then fetch multi-venue crypto VWAP, bid/ask quotes, FX rates, metals prices and tokenized equities, each with timestamps and provenance. Signed-in users with a verified email receive 30,000 free live-data credits every calendar month under an evaluation licence with "Data by Blocksize" attribution; subscriptions start at EUR 49/month with a free trial. The plugin never trades, moves funds, signs wallet messages or gives investment advice.
defaultPrompt: What is the current multi-venue VWAP for BTC/USD?
Compare the bid/ask spreads for ETH/USD and SOL/USD.
What are the latest EUR/USD rate and gold price?

positive.expected_behavior: Returns SOLUSD and related pairs with their asset class and available services; no live price and no charge.

positive.prompt: What is the current multi-venue VWAP for BTC/USD?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the BTCUSD VWAP with a UTC timestamp, provider provenance and the remaining monthly credit line.

positive.prompt: Show the ETH/USD bid and ask.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns bid, ask and spread for ETHUSD with a timestamp.

positive.prompt: What are the latest EUR/USD rate and gold price?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the EURUSD mid rate and the XAUUSD price, each with a timestamp.

positive.prompt: How many free Blocksize credits do I have left this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the monthly limit, credits spent, credits remaining and the reset date.

negative.description: Investment advice is out of scope
negative.prompt: Should I invest in ETH right now?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments; live data is covered by free monthly credits.

publication.release_notes: First directory release: instrument search, live multi-venue crypto VWAP and bid/ask, FX and metals prices, tokenized equity quotes, and a credit balance tool, with 30,000 free live-data credits a month for signed-in users.
